hooks.name: RAG Framework Guard
hooks.description: Prompts for confirmation before any command or file edit that mentions LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack, LangGraph or similar. The brief requires building the RAG pipeline manually, so pulling in a framework should be a deliberate, discussed decision rather than a reflex.

action.command: $payload=[Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); if($payload -match '(?i)(langchain|llama[-_]?index|haystack|langgraph|embedchain|semantic[-_]kernel|txtai)'){ Write-Output '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"This mentions a RAG framework (LangChain / LlamaIndex / Haystack / LangGraph / EmbedChain / txtai). Project 2 requires building chunk-embed-store-retrieve by hand - see .kiro/steering/learning-guardrails.md. Approve only if this is a deliberate exception, or if the framework is merely being named in prose or a comparison."}}' }; exit 0
